allow_large: Four code files plus tests; the owner decided on 2026-10-01 that tests don't count toward the fix limit (the installed release still counts them)
done_when: forge close merges the default branch first and stops with the conflict before taking the machine's test lock or starting a review; and when the test command fails, close stops before the review, records the failing output for the next worker round, and says so in one line, instead of running a review that reports the same failure. Command-level tests: a conflicting merge stops before any test run or review, and a failing test command stops before the review with its output kept for the worker.

findings.body: The selected diff adds only a tracking record; it implements no failing-test gate. In src/forge/review.py:292–305, a nonzero test exit becomes review-prompt text, and review.run continues launching the reviewer after constructing that prompt at line 396. This matches the supplied close run: tests exited 1 and this review still started. Close already merges the default branch first (src/forge/close.py:73), but the remaining required behavior is absent: stop on test failure, preserve its output for the next worker round, and report that stop in one line.
findings.title: Not done: forge close must stop before review on failed tests and retain the output for the next worker round

findings.body: No test is added for the promised conflict ordering. The existing conflict case in tests/test_close.py:346–353 checks the conflict message, and its shared assertions at lines 419–435 check refusal and merge cleanup. It neither configures a test command nor asserts that tests and review were never started, so moving either before the merge could leave this case passing. Extend the real-command test to prove conflict detection happens before acquiring the machine test lock, running tests, or invoking review.
findings.title: Not done: command test proves a merge conflict stops before the test lock, test command, or review

findings.body: The selected change adds no command-level regression for the failing-test stop or worker handoff. The existing test in tests/test_fix_close_reruns_the_full_test_command_even.py:59–68 leaves the test command failing but explicitly expects a later close to succeed when the mocked reviewer returns clean. It protects the old behavior rather than the required refusal. Add a real forge close test that asserts nonzero exit, no reviewer invocation, the one-line stop message, and delivery of the captured failure output to the next worker round.
findings.title: Not done: command test proves failed tests stop review and preserve their output for the next worker

why: Close spends a full review (about 15 minutes) on a change whose test command already failed, and re-closes queue for the test lock before finding a merge conflict with the default branch
